simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פַּרְשְׁדֹן (H6574) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: פַּרְשְׁדֹן (parshᵉdôn) means the crotch (or anus) First listed occurrence: Judg 3 22.

definitions.full: H6574. parshedonah מַּרְשְׁדֹ֑נָה noun [masculine] only הַמּ ׳וַיֵּצֵא Judg 3:22 , read perhaps מֶּרֶשׁ foeces ( ᵑ7 ᵑ9 Nö Untersuch. 180 Bu GFM). פַרְשֵׁז see מַּרְשֵׂז below פרשׂ .
definitions.rootNote: perhaps by compounding 6567 and 6504 (in the sense of straddling) (compare 6576 );
